value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task states an order — 'If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box' — so the box pickup happens after taking the key, yet the candidate has only Existence(target_picked_up) with no ordering clause. Add a hard Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up) to record the stated order; keep the hard RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) and the hard Existence(target_picked_up), which the chain then forces nothing extra on.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) matches 'If you move the ball, you must also take the key'; Existence(target_picked_up) captures the commanded 'pick up the box in the other room'; the hard Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up) records the 'Then' order stated by the task. The redundant R1 stays because it is an 'if' rule the task states.
